smap.dataset: NASA SMAP L4 V8 surface and root-zone soil moisture
smap.resolution: ~9-11 km; effective support noted in rows
smap.qualityNote: Missing values are blank; never interpret missing as zero.

rainfall.dataset: NASA GPM IMERG V07 daily precipitation
rainfall.qualityNote: Missing values are blank; never interpret missing as zero.

era5.qualityNote: Missing values are blank; never interpret missing as zero.

landsat.resolution: 30 m output grid; thermal native support about 100 m
landsat.qualityNote: Missing values are blank; never interpret missing as zero.

modis.qualityNote: Missing values are blank; never interpret missing as zero.

sentinel2.dataset: Sentinel-2 Surface Reflectance Harmonized bare-soil index
sentinel2.qualityNote: Missing values are blank; never interpret missing as zero.

soilgrids.dataset: ISRIC SoilGrids v2 modelled soil properties by depth
soilgrids.qualityNote: Eight properties × six depth layers. Values are modelled and scale-adjusted.

srtm.dataset: SRTM elevation and derived slope summary
srtm.qualityNote: One mean buffer summary; not parcel boundary/cadastral survey.

gracefo.dataset: JPL GRACE/GRACE-FO mascon terrestrial water-storage anomaly
gracefo.qualityNote: 261 time records. Regional total water-storage anomaly; not a farm aquifer or borewell measurement.

cgwb.resolution: Station points; distances from test coordinate included
cgwb.qualityNote: 78 Jalandhar district stations, not farm-specific wells.

agmarknetPrices.qualityNote: Monthly market-level summaries only; not daily trades or farm-gate prices.

agmarknetArrivals.qualityNote: Monthly reported arrivals are supply inflow, not consumer demand.

desApy.dataset: DES district APY statistics (normalized from supplied report)
desApy.units: area ha; production tonnes or bales; yield per hectare
desApy.qualityNote: District statistics; missing report cells remain blank.

nasaPower.dataset: NASA POWER daily point weather API
nasaPower.resolution: NASA POWER native gridded support; not a field station
nasaPower.units: T2M_MIN/T2M_MAX: ?C; PRECTOTCORR: mm/day; EVPTRNS: MJ/m?/day energy flux
nasaPower.qualityNote: Supplemental public data; EVPTRNS is energy flux, not an evapotranspiration depth. Do not convert/label it as mm of ET.

agmarknetCoverage.qualityNote: Coverage is sparse: actual returned observations appear for four of six commodities only.
